report_discrepancies.note: Governmental funds statement: printed Total expenditures 1,086,218.96, but the printed expenditure lines add to 1,086,068.96. The schedule p14 shows the same 150.00 gap in the General department column (printed 477,608.16 vs lines 477,458.16); rows tie across the departments. The printed fund-balance roll-forward uses the 1,086,218.96 total, so the governmental identity built from the lines is off by 150.00.
General Fund Schedule of Expenditures: printed Total 2,773,034.66 vs lines 2,772,884.66 (General department column printed 477,608.16 vs lines 477,458.16).

Proprietary statement: Water column Total operating expenses printed 321,420.92 but its lines add to 321,293.25; Total column printed 1,754,007.69 vs lines 1,753,880.02. Each row ties across columns. The printed net position roll-forward uses the printed totals, so the business-type roll from the lines is off by 127.67.
Water Fund detail (proprietary statement column): printed Total operating expenses 321,420.92 vs lines 321,293.25; detail total uses the printed figure.

Nonmajor combining statement: Waste Total operating expenses printed 196,471.50 vs lines 196,381.75; the 89.75 is the Miscellaneous expense printed in the proprietary statement's Other column (p9) but omitted from the combining statement's lines.

notes: GAAP (modified accrual governmental funds, accrual proprietary). Only one governmental fund (General). Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balance (pp4-5), expenditures listed by object (function taken from the General Fund departmental schedule p14 where a line sits in one department; mixed lines general government with review). Intergovernmental 265,534.62 and Charges for services 8,077.80 split using the p13 breakdown (ties exactly). 'Note Payment' (1,626,815.70) printed under other financing uses recorded as other_financing; p14 shows it as Debt Service and bond issue cost (Street). Ending cash = Cash held by County Treasurer 8,470.21 (p3); CDs 870,189.58 in ending_investments; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (pp8-9); reported business-type receipts are computed (operating + nonoperating revenues, no single printed total); disbursements = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 1,789,716.16 (p2). Operating 'Other' revenue kept other: the Statement of Activities counts it in general revenues 'Other receipts' (75,215.53 + 48,450 + 10,000 = 133,665.53), not charges for services. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position split by Governmental/Business-type columns. Detail: General Fund revenues (p13) and departmental expenditures (p14); Ambulance and Waste from the nonmajor combining statement (p15); Electric, Water, Sewer and Golf from their proprietary statement columns (pp8-9), as in FY2024; the all-funds budget schedule (p12) is a combined schedule and is not recorded. Report's own totals off by 150.00 (governmental expenditures), 127.67 (Water operating expenses) and 89.75 (Waste combining) - see report_discrepancies. Read pages 1-16 of 16
